title: Change all white text to black for readability in light mode

requirements.text: Update all white text colors to black throughout the website for better readability against light backgrounds in light mode, including headings, body text, section titles, and all text elements in HeroSection, GameplaySection, RewardsSection, ShopInfoSection, CallToAction, and Footer components

quotes: can u add more interesting animations and more interesting prospects?
as you can see the text in white ("REWARDS") is unreadable ,so make it black
yes change everything from white to black in the text and continue

acceptanceCriteria: All white text (#FFFFFF, rgb(255,255,255), or equivalent) is changed to black (#000000 or dark gray) in light mode
The 'Achievements' heading with 'REWARDS' text is clearly readable with black color
All section headings, body text, and descriptive text are black in light mode
Text maintains proper contrast and readability against the light purple/lavender backgrounds
Dark mode text colors remain unchanged (white text for dark backgrounds)
